top.line: Onboarding by interview: from "I want to try it" to editing your own site with Claude.
top.para: Material any way, designs from sites you like.

in-short.line: Interview first, the brief, material any way, designs inspired by sites you like, the milestone.

start.line: Today the first step is an email; most people do not know what they want until asked.
start.para: Both markets hit the same moment.

interview.line: Claude interviews: purpose, sections, what you have, sites you like, what to avoid; then a brief.
interview.para: It shows what they are about to get.

inspired.line: Pointing at sites you like is a better design brief; the five designs read the qualities named.

material.line: A zip, an email, links, a vault, or in the interview itself, where Claude can start building.

existing.line: An existing site is the material; the designs are better versions of it.

milestone.line: The milestone is the owner changing their own site by talking to Claude; hand-over is the middle.

prompt.line: A five-line interview prompt anyone could paste into Claude today.
prompt.para: The real one carries our checks.

first.line: A where-to-start page with the interview, the brief as a file, sites you like, an existing-site route.

limits.line: A design, not built; the vault route not built end to end; inspired never means copied.

sources.line: agenticcells.ai's start page and earlier articles.
